originality.rationale: The new claim is the unique *spatial* sign reversal of the weak-restart response at an exact speed-reactivity threshold in the partially reactive central-target/sticky-wall RTP model. The same model and uniform first/second moments were previously published and are not presented as new. Closest full texts either have a different wall/target mechanism, a half-line geometry, or optimize propulsion/tumbling instead of position-conditional weak restart; no inspected claim implies the Bernstein single-crossing theorem. Bibliographic noncoverage remains uncertain.
residual_risks: Relevant unindexed manuscripts or appendices may have an equivalent hidden point-start restart sign result; bibliographic searches are not uniqueness proofs.
The 2023 original article's other moment identities may allow a comparatively short derivation of the result even though it does not state the spatial classification.
No external independent mathematical validation has been performed; proof and computations underwent only the documented same-model review.
